correctness.rationale: For every prime p≥5 the facets are all unordered cyclic triples {a,a+d,a+2d}; each pair of vertices is an edge, all facets have distinct midpoint and the face vector is (p, p(p−1)/2, p(p−1)/2). Free translation by Zp on the two-dimensional realization gives a regular covering with quotient presentation <e_d | e_−d=e_d^−1, e_2d=e_d²>. Signed multiplication by 2 partitions nonzero residues mod sign into q=(p−1)/(2h) cycles; eliminating generators yields free product of q cyclic groups C_N, N=2^h−σ. Each maps onto Zp under monodromy. Bass–Serre index-p kernel quotient graph has p+q vertices, pq edges and q peripheral stabilizers C_(N/p); its free rank is (p−1)(q−1). Abelianization gives H1 including exact torsion and Euler characteristic p gives free H2 of rank q(p−1), no higher homology. Fresh independently built exact integral Smith boundary matrices for p=5,7,11,13 (including H1 torsion C3,C5 at 11,13) agree; source verifier checked 12 primes but was not fully replayed. Proof is group-theoretic for all primes, not extrapolated from four finite examples.
